label: incomplete
criteria: Report does not crash on unparseable served_by: The report command SHALL NOT raise an unhandled ValueError when a ledger row holds a served_by value that urlsplit cannot parse.
Unparseable backend shows as unknown: The report SHALL display the serving backend as unknown for a row whose served_by value urlsplit cannot parse.
Valid served_by values still resolve: The report SHALL resolve a valid served_by value to its local or hosted classification as before.
note: The three spec scenarios say `devops ai cost report --by backend` exits 0 and shows `unknown`. The tasks test only _is_single_server_local and is_local. No task asserts the command or the table label. A guard test alone would not prove the scenarios. The plan also gives no test names, so the Feasibility check `-k unparseable` selects nothing unless the implementer picks that word.
